items.title: Myasthenia gravis market to reach $13.0bn across 7MM by 2034
items.summary: The myasthenia gravis (MG) market across the 7MM is poised to grow at a CAGR of 11.1% from $4.5bn in 2024 to $13.0bn in 2034.

items.title: Lilly’s Mounjaro wins US label expansion for cardiovascular risk reduction
items.summary: The new Mounjaro approval will likely expand Lilly’s cardiometabolic empire as it looks to stay ahead of rival Novo Nordisk.

items.title: FDA approves Priovant’s rare autoimmune therapy Lisraya in indication first
items.summary: Priovant is now looking to roll out Lisraya, the first targeted therapy for dermatomyositis, across the US via specialty pharmacies.

items.title: MSD’s Lipfendra takes on injectable rivals for cholesterol-lowering market supremacy
items.summary: Armed with oral administration and a cheaper price tag, Lipfendra is touted as a major advancement for patients.

items.title: AusperBio raises $120m to progress hepatitis B therapies
items.summary: AusperBio Therapeutics and Ausper Biopharma have closed a Series C funding round worth $120m to support the development of new therapies for chronic hepatitis B.
